title: Regular Immersion Signed Evaluation
statement: In the finite small pro-etale coefficient setting [def-pur-conventions], use the signed shifted Tate line T_X(r)=A_X(r)\lbrack 2r\rbrack and exceptional functor of [def-pur-regular-immersion-class-data]. Define T_X(c)⊗T_X(-c)→A_X\lbrack 0\rbrack by the actual finite root-line dual evaluation, strong monoidal etale-to-pro-etale comparison, degree-zero tensor localization and the right-shift-first tensor comparison; identify 2c+2(-c)=0. For i:Z→X define Li* T_X(r)≅T_Z(r) using the root/dual-normalized signed Tate pullback of [def-pur-supported-class-operations] and exact derived-single and shift comparisons. No arbitrary evaluation or pullback map is input data.
